title: Corrected Validation Protocol

historical_baseline_context.interpretation: Historical metrics are retained as originally reported. They are not leakage-free deployment metrics.

identified_evaluation_problems.evidence: Original test pipeline selects the sample with minimum future-ground-truth ADE and takes FDE from that sample.
identified_evaluation_problems.consequence: The selected sample cannot be selected at deployment because future ground truth is unavailable.
identified_evaluation_problems.correction: Use deterministic single-sample prediction or a predeclared stochastic aggregation/selection rule that does not inspect future ground truth.

identified_evaluation_problems.evidence: Original rollout uses future pedestrian lists/presence to construct subsequent interaction grids.
identified_evaluation_problems.consequence: Future actor presence is supplied to the rollout.
identified_evaluation_problems.correction: Use only observed tracks, tracker outputs, predicted positions, and an explicit track birth/death policy.

identified_evaluation_problems.issue: Future vehicle information in method-4 rollout
identified_evaluation_problems.evidence: Original method-4 rollout uses future vehicle lists and future vehicle states when constructing later interaction grids.
identified_evaluation_problems.consequence: Future vehicle states/presence are unavailable in real-time deployment.
identified_evaluation_problems.correction: Propagate observed vehicle tracks using a motion model or tracker predictions; do not use future annotations.

identified_evaluation_problems.issue: Temporal overlap across retained train/test windows
identified_evaluation_problems.evidence: Authoritative Task 5 audit found 66 overlapping cross-split window pairs and 11 shared timeline frame indices.
identified_evaluation_problems.consequence: Some test windows share temporal frames with training windows.
identified_evaluation_problems.correction: Apply a chronological purge boundary and preferably scene-independent evaluation where possible.

allowed_inputs: Observed actor IDs from a real tracker
Camera calibration only if independently verified
Tracker-estimated actor states based on observations
prohibited_inputs: Future pedestrian ground-truth positions during rollout
Future pedestrian ground-truth IDs or presence lists
Future vehicle ground-truth positions during rollout
Future vehicle ground-truth IDs or presence lists
Future annotations used to construct interaction grids
Future ground truth used to select prediction samples

actor_management.track_initialization: Initialize tracks only from detections in observed frames.
actor_management.track_identity: Maintain persistent IDs through an online tracker.
actor_management.track_propagation: Use tracker predictions or a documented motion model.
actor_management.track_birth: A new actor may enter only after an actual detector observation during deployment.
actor_management.track_death: Use a documented missing-observation timeout or tracker termination policy.

corrected_protocol.interaction_grid_rollout: At each future step, build interaction inputs from predicted actor states and deployment-feasible track estimates. Never query future annotation arrays.

prediction_selection.alternative: Predeclared stochastic aggregation such as mean trajectory or distribution parameters.
prediction_selection.oracle_best_of_n: May be shown only as a separately labelled oracle upper bound, never as the deployment metric.

data_split.preferred: Scene/camera-independent split when multiple scenes are available.
data_split.fallback: Chronological train/validation/test split with purge gap.
data_split.purge_requirement: No 12-frame sequence may cross a split boundary. The purge must account for the complete input plus prediction window.

evaluation_metrics: Brier score for predicted conflict probabilities
Precision and recall at declared alert thresholds

acceptance_criteria: No future ground-truth actor positions or presence enter rollout.
No future ground-truth vehicle states or presence enter rollout.
No future ground truth is used to select a prediction sample.
All interaction grids are generated from observed or predicted states.
Train/validation/test windows obey a documented purge policy.
Historical oracle/leaky metrics are kept separate from corrected metrics.
The corrected evaluation code is tested with future annotations hidden.
not_yet_claimed: The corrected protocol has not yet been implemented.
No leakage-free metrics have yet been measured.
No deployment FPS has yet been established.
No calibrated conflict probabilities have yet been validated.
